summary: Replaced fixed 4-level dirname() walk in inferProjectRootFromPlanPath() with anchor-based algorithm: splits the normalized path into segments, finds the first i where segments[i]==='docs' and segments[i+1]==='agents', returns segments[0..i-1].join('/') or null if not found.
